page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a KVM-based GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs combined with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual CPU core. The host includes dual discrete NVIDIA P100 graphics processing units delivering a total of 32 GB of VRAM across both cards. Local storage is provided via 944 GB of SSD capacity, while network throughput is supported by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth configuration.

The inclusion of dual NVIDIA P100 GPUs alongside host memory and local SSD storage offers dedicated resource density for parallel compute tasks. However, the GPU hardware lacks modern matrix acceleration extensions found in newer generations. The allocated 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core balances multi-threaded host operations against GPU execution. This hardware configuration fits parallel computing, deep learning inference, image processing, and technical simulations that leverage CUDA acceleration combined with moderate host memory and local storage demands.
